sections.Profile:
"Vegas" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1990, featuring a casino theme. It includes two flippers, no ramps, and a two-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 3 series, it was designed by Jon Norris with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell. A total of 1,500 units were produced.
